function prepare(P)
    N = P.N
    n = P.n
    
    # Precompute LU factorizations for horizontal lines
    # h_l[i,j] for i=2..N, j=1..N: multiplier
    # h_u[i,j] for i=1..N, j=1..N: modified diagonal
    h_l = zeros(N, N)
    h_u = zeros(N, N)
    
    for j in 1:N
        idx1 = 1 + N*(j-1)
        h_u[1,j] = P.diag[idx1]
        for i in 2:N
            idx = i + N*(j-1)
            h_l[i,j] = -P.tw[i,j] / h_u[i-1,j]
            h_u[i,j] = P.diag[idx] - h_l[i,j] * (-P.te[i-1,j])
        end
    end
    
    # Vertical lines
    v_l = zeros(N, N)
    v_u = zeros(N, N)
    
    for i in 1:N
        v_u[1,i] = P.diag[i]  # j=1
        for j in 2:N
            idx = i + N*(j-1)
            v_l[j,i] = -P.ts[i,j] / v_u[j-1,i]
            v_u[j,i] = P.diag[idx] - v_l[j,i] * (-P.tn[i,j-1])
        end
    end
    
    # Coarse grid: 16x16
    nc = 16
    ncoarse = nc * nc
    ratio = N ÷ nc  # should be 4 for N=64
    
    R = zeros(ncoarse, n)
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        coarse_idx = ci + nc * (cj - 1)
        for dj in 1:ratio, di in 1:ratio
            fi = (ci - 1) * ratio + di
            fj = (cj - 1) * ratio + dj
            fine_idx = fi + N * (fj - 1)
            R[coarse_idx, fine_idx] = 1.0 / (ratio * ratio)
        end
    end
    
    # Galerkin projection: Ac = R * A * R'
    ARt = zeros(n, ncoarse)
    e = zeros(n)
    tmp = zeros(n)
    for j in 1:ncoarse
        e .= 0.0
        for i in 1:n
            e[i] = R[j, i]
        end
        matvec!(tmp, P, e)
        for i in 1:n
            ARt[i, j] = tmp[i]
        end
    end
    
    Ac = zeros(ncoarse, ncoarse)
    for i in 1:ncoarse, j in 1:ncoarse
        s = 0.0
        for k in 1:n
            s += R[i, k] * ARt[k, j]
        end
        Ac[i, j] = s
    end
    
    F = cholesky(Symmetric(Ac))
    
    Rt = zeros(n, ncoarse)
    for i in 1:ncoarse, j in 1:n
        Rt[j, i] = R[i, j]
    end
    
    return (h_l=h_l, h_u=h_u, v_l=v_l, v_u=v_u,
            F=F, R=R, Rt=Rt, ncoarse=ncoarse, nc=nc)
end

function prepare(P)
    N = P.N
    n = P.n
    
    # Precompute LU factorizations for horizontal line tridiagonal systems
    h_l = zeros(N, N)  # multipliers, h_l[1,:] unused
    h_u = zeros(N, N)  # modified diagonals
    
    for j in 1:N
        idx1 = 1 + N * (j - 1)
        h_u[1, j] = P.diag[idx1]
        for i in 2:N
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            h_l[i, j] = -P.tw[i, j] / h_u[i-1, j]
            h_u[i, j] = P.diag[idx] - h_l[i, j] * (-P.te[i-1, j])
        end
    end
    
    # Precompute LU factorizations for vertical line tridiagonal systems
    v_l = zeros(N, N)  # v_l[1,:] unused
    v_u = zeros(N, N)
    
    for i in 1:N
        v_u[1, i] = P.diag[i]  # j=1
        for j in 2:N
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            v_l[j, i] = -P.ts[i, j] / v_u[j-1, i]
            v_u[j, i] = P.diag[idx] - v_l[j, i] * (-P.tn[i, j-1])
        end
    end
    
    # Build coarse grid restriction (16x16 averaging)
    nc = 16
    ncoarse = nc * nc
    ratio = N ÷ nc
    
    R = zeros(ncoarse, n)
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        coarse_idx = ci + nc * (cj - 1)
        for dj in 1:ratio, di in 1:ratio
            fi = (ci - 1) * ratio + di
            fj = (cj - 1) * ratio + dj
            fine_idx = fi + N * (fj - 1)
            R[coarse_idx, fine_idx] = 1.0 / (ratio * ratio)
        end
    end
    
    # Galerkin projection: Ac = R * A * R'
    ARt = zeros(n, ncoarse)
    e = zeros(n)
    tmp = zeros(n)
    for j in 1:ncoarse
        e .= 0.0
        for i in 1:n
            e[i] = R[j, i]
        end
        matvec!(tmp, P, e)
        for i in 1:n
            ARt[i, j] = tmp[i]
        end
    end
    
    Ac = zeros(ncoarse, ncoarse)
    for i in 1:ncoarse, j in 1:ncoarse
        s = 0.0
        for k in 1:n
            s += R[i, k] * ARt[k, j]
        end
        Ac[i, j] = s
    end
    
    F = cholesky(Symmetric(Ac))
    
    Rt = zeros(n, ncoarse)
    for i in 1:ncoarse, j in 1:n
        Rt[j, i] = R[i, j]
    end
    
    return (h_l=h_l, h_u=h_u, v_l=v_l, v_u=v_u,
            F=F, R=R, Rt=Rt, ncoarse=ncoarse)
end

function setup(P, C, θ)
    dinv = 1.0 ./ P.diag
    return (dinv=dinv,
            y=zeros(P.N),
            v0=zeros(P.n), v1=zeros(P.n), v2=zeros(P.n),
            v3=zeros(P.n), v4=zeros(P.n),
            w=zeros(P.n),
            rc=zeros(C.ncoarse), zc=zeros(C.ncoarse),
            h_l=C.h_l, h_u=C.h_u, v_l=C.v_l, v_u=C.v_u,
            R=C.R, Rt=C.Rt, F=C.F, ncoarse=C.ncoarse)
end

function solve_horizontal_lines!(out, w, P, S)
    N = P.N
    for j in 1:N
        # Forward substitution
        S.y[1] = w[1 + N * (j - 1)]
        for i in 2:N
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            S.y[i] = w[idx] - S.h_l[i, j] * S.y[i-1]
        end
        # Back substitution
        out[N + N * (j - 1)] = S.y[N] / S.h_u[N, j]
        for i in N-1:-1:1
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            out[idx] = (S.y[i] - (-P.te[i, j]) * out[idx + 1]) / S.h_u[i, j]
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function solve_vertical_lines!(out, w, P, S)
    N = P.N
    for i in 1:N
        # Forward substitution
        S.y[1] = w[i]
        for j in 2:N
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            S.y[j] = w[idx] - S.v_l[j, i] * S.y[j-1]
        end
        # Back substitution
        out[i + N * (N - 1)] = S.y[N] / S.v_u[N, i]
        for j in N-1:-1:1
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            out[idx] = (S.y[j] - (-P.tn[i, j]) * out[idx + N]) / S.v_u[j, i]
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function restrict!(rc, w, S)
    for i in 1:S.ncoarse
        s = 0.0
        for j in 1:length(w)
            s += S.R[i, j] * w[j]
        end
        rc[i] = s
    end
    return nothing
end

function interpolate_add!(z, zc, S, weight)
    for j in 1:length(z)
        s = 0.0
        for i in 1:S.ncoarse
            s += S.Rt[j, i] * zc[i]
        end
        z[j] += weight * s
    end
    return nothing
end

function apply_polynomial!(z, r, P, S, θ, start_idx, weight)
    # v0 = D^{-1} r
    S.v0 .= S.dinv .* r
    z .+= weight * θ[start_idx] .* S.v0
    
    # v1 = D^{-1} A v0
    matvec!(S.w, P, S.v0)
    S.v1 .= S.dinv .* S.w
    z .+= weight * θ[start_idx + 1] .* S.v1
    
    # v2 = D^{-1} A v1
    matvec!(S.w, P, S.v1)
    S.v2 .= S.dinv .* S.w
    z .+= weight * θ[start_idx + 2] .* S.v2
    
    # v3
    matvec!(S.w, P, S.v2)
    S.v3 .= S.dinv .* S.w
    z .+= weight * θ[start_idx + 3] .* S.v3
    
    # v4
    matvec!(S.w, P, S.v3)
    S.v4 .= S.dinv .* S.w
    z .+= weight * θ[start_idx + 4] .* S.v4
    
    return nothing
end

function precond!(z, r, P, S, θ)

function prepare(P)
    N = P.N
    n = P.n
    
    # Precompute LU factorizations for horizontal line tridiagonal systems
    h_l = zeros(N, N)
    h_u = zeros(N, N)
    
    for j in 1:N
        idx1 = 1 + N * (j - 1)
        h_u[1, j] = P.diag[idx1]
        for i in 2:N
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            h_l[i, j] = -P.tw[i, j] / h_u[i-1, j]
            h_u[i, j] = P.diag[idx] - h_l[i, j] * (-P.te[i-1, j])
        end
    end
    
    # Precompute LU factorizations for vertical line tridiagonal systems
    v_l = zeros(N, N)
    v_u = zeros(N, N)
    
    for i in 1:N
        v_u[1, i] = P.diag[i]
        for j in 2:N
            idx = i + N * (j - 1)
            v_l[j, i] = -P.ts[i, j] / v_u[j-1, i]
            v_u[j, i] = P.diag[idx] - v_l[j, i] * (-P.tn[i, j-1])
        end
    end
    
    # Build coarse grid restriction (16x16 averaging)
    nc = 16
    ncoarse = nc * nc
    ratio = N ÷ nc
    
    R = zeros(ncoarse, n)
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        coarse_idx = ci + nc * (cj - 1)
        for dj in 1:ratio, di in 1:ratio
            fi = (ci - 1) * ratio + di
            fj = (cj - 1) * ratio + dj
            fine_idx = fi + N * (fj - 1)
            R[coarse_idx, fine_idx] = 1.0 / (ratio * ratio)
        end
    end
    
    # Galerkin projection: Ac = R * A * R'
    ARt = zeros(n, ncoarse)
    e = zeros(n)
    tmp = zeros(n)
    for j in 1:ncoarse
        e .= 0.0
        for i in 1:n
            e[i] = R[j, i]
        end
        matvec!(tmp, P, e)
        for i in 1:n
            ARt[i, j] = tmp[i]
        end
    end
    
    Ac = zeros(ncoarse, ncoarse)
    for i in 1:ncoarse, j in 1:ncoarse
        s = 0.0
        for k in 1:n
            s += R[i, k] * ARt[k, j]
        end
        Ac[i, j] = s
    end
    
    F = cholesky(Symmetric(Ac))

    for i in 1:ncoarse, j in 1:n

    end
    
    return (h_l=h_l, h_u=h_u, v_l=v_l, v_u=v_u,
